sec: sec:The rule learned the hard way

blocks.id: blk:The rule learned the hard way/1
blocks.text: From the v0.4.37 release note, quoted in Chapter 7:

sentences.text: From the v0.4.37 release note, quoted in Chapter 7:

blocks.id: blk:The rule learned the hard way/2
blocks.text:
a zombie headless Chromium from a crashed test run held the debug port and served stale
modules to every later test on that port, making a working feature look broken; the fix
was kill, not code

blocks.id: blk:The rule learned the hard way/3
blocks.text: Two operational rules follow, and they are not optional:

sentences.text: Two operational rules follow, and they are not optional:

blocks.id: blk:The rule learned the hard way/4
blocks.text:
Never reuse a port. Not the browser's debug port, not the web server's port. One run,
  one port, forever.

sentences.text: Not the browser's debug port, not the web server's port.
